jobs.title: Sanctum local Casual source prototype
jobs.summary: First-person Rama, two-site Sangam Crossing, economy and local 5v5 Casual are implemented and pass focused integrated checks. One human plays with nine bots; first to 13 wins, sides swap after round 12. This completes the bounded source prototype, not final art, online play or a new public executable.
jobs.next_step: Qualify ordinary native input and portable delivery, then finish one coherent Rama/site art pass.

jobs.title: Round rules and local bot match
jobs.summary: 717 focused assertions passed across tactical rules/bots/map/UI/world, classic regressions, native contracts and package/source provenance. The current UI has 37 checks. One actual-scene bot match completed 24 rounds, Moon 13–11 Sun, with 8 plants, 1 defuse and 153 eliminations. Normal-clock world shutdown is clean; the accelerated audio-shutdown failure remains recorded separately.
jobs.next_step: Human feel/balance, listening and ordinary-input acceptance remain separate from these automated local checks.

jobs.title: Rama kit, Sangam map and native screens

Four unchanged originals are displayed here. Staged views do not establish ordinary input, continuous motion, final art or physical-GPU performance.
jobs.next_step: Complete ordinary input and motion review, refine one representative weapon/site encounter, and obtain human art/feel acceptance.
